subject: integration
name: Orivon's EthFS node
summary: The node Orivon runs to read files kept on Ethereum in EthFS and to store them for a site that is allowed to. Open source. It holds no key and opens no connection: reads go through the Ethereum nodes the person chose, and every byte is held against the address that names it, so a node can withhold a file and cannot change it. A filename becomes an address by a contract read: proven by the light client, the node's word if one that proves nothing is used. A store is one sheet, signed only on confirm. Not private: the node that answers sees which files are read. Judged here by its publisher.
